reviews.text: Excellent service, from the initial phone call to picking up my dog. The grooming/hygienic bathing service was excellent. I found them through Chatgpt, confirmed the Google reviews, and it was well worth it!

I took my granddaughter Drica to this pet shop, and I thought it was wonderful. From the reception to especially the grooming and bathing service. She looked exactly as I asked the groomer, and even better than I imagined. It was the first of many times. We'll only take her there from now on. Even though it's not that close to my daughter Maria's house (Drica's mother), it's worth it.

I took my dog ​​to get her V10 and rabies vaccines with Dr. Keila, and she was super attentive! She asked several questions about her health history, did a physical exam, and gave my dog ​​a treat while she was on the table. We loved it!
Oh, the reception staff is also super attentive, both via WhatsApp and in person.
The service from the pet shop staff was excellent. Even better was the attentiveness of the veterinarian. We were very satisfied with the consultation.
I highly recommend it!

Excellent service.
The smell of the place, the atmosphere, is wonderful...
My experience at Don Pet was wonderful. The staff were excellent and very polite. I loved it. My pet was well treated, the baths were good, and my pet smelled great. I recommend them to everyone.
Vitor's service is impeccable ❤️ Congratulations on hiring such people!
Very attentive

Excellent environment, with qualified professionals and excellent products.

I recommend it 100%! My experience with my pet was great! 🔥🔥 …

They are all very polite, they treated my dog ​​with respect and kindness, I was very happy.

Gustavo from the grooming salon is an excellent professional, everyone at reception is also very professional.

It's a place where mixed-breed dogs are welcome (as is the case with mine).

We booked a bath and grooming appointment in advance for today at 1 PM. I arrived, and two attendants at the counter barely greeted me. I told them I had an appointment, they took my information, said they couldn't find anything, and even suggested a pet shop right upstairs. I felt like an idiot. I've already shared this with the condo group who usually take their pets there. Never again!
Very attentive and professional staff, and fair prices! My pet and I simply love Don Pet.

A complete pet place, very well located in the heart of the capital. Pet care from the very first step. Excellent veterinary clinical staff, plus solutions for the needs of pet owners and pets in the region, from products to grooming.
My dogs love going to Don Pet! The staff are so kind and attentive to us, and even more so to our pets! Thank you so much for everything!!!
Perfect experience from start to finish! Great service and attention.
We've been customers since it opened. The facilities are great for bathing and grooming, the staff is very attentive, and they have a good variety of products.
Excellent service, polite staff, and good grooming!

Don Pet is practically my little darling's second home! He's treated incredibly well, with lots of love and attention. Top-notch service!! The whole team is very professional and well-prepared. Whenever I needed them, they provided the necessary support! 🐕😀🙌🙏⭐ …
Highly competent and attentive professionals with pets. And very patient too, especially with mine, who is not easy to handle, but they all manage it perfectly. I always recommend them!
Excellent service, bathing and grooming, products, and veterinary care! 🥰👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼 …
Sensational service, extremely polite staff, fantastic experience, I highly recommend it!
Very friendly and professional environment.
Fantastic!
I received excellent service and Meg loved the bath.
Best store, care, attention and affection for my puppies!!

I am writing to formally express my dissatisfaction with the veterinary appointment we recently scheduled. My fiancée took our cat to the clinic and, upon arrival, was informed that the veterinarian would not be present, which caused us great frustration. The journey was stressful for both her and our pet, and no prior notice was given about the veterinarian's absence, which could have avoided all the inconvenience.

Given this situation, and the lack of consideration we felt as clients, we have decided that we will not return to the clinic. This episode has left us extremely disappointed, and we hope it serves as a warning for more efficient communication in the future, preventing other clients from experiencing something similar.

I've been to this pet shop, which also has a veterinary clinic, a few times. Both with my dog ​​and my cat. This last time was a total lack of care and disrespect for the customer.
The doctor is available on WhatsApp if you have any questions, so I contacted her on the 23rd at 2 pm to talk about my pet's condition. They replied at 5 pm (the doctor leaves at 4 pm) to schedule an appointment. Okay! I scheduled it for Saturday the 26th at 10 am. It was a follow-up appointment because treatment has been ongoing for a little over a month. I arrived at the location and was informed that the doctor wouldn't be coming because she was sick. They told me she had notified them, but they 'didn't have time' to contact me, so I left my house with a stressed cat, because anyone who has a cat knows that leaving home is very stressful for them, including going to the vet, which has many smells of other animals, for nothing. Details: there was no other vet to cover for the doctor, and my trip was wasted. I received absolutely no support; all I heard was: "She's sick, she told us this morning and couldn't let you know."

Terrible service, terrible management, I'm not going back. Zero commitment to patients. Or at least to my cat! And to think it's a private place, nothing is free, and we still had to go through all this trouble. I do not recommend the place. Dr. Keila is great, but the place and management leave much to be desired.
Excellent service
Friendly and attentive service towards my dog ​​(who is difficult to handle, haha).
I highly recommend this excellent pet shop; the staff is super dedicated and attentive.

At Don Pet they are very attentive to Oreo, the services are of very high quality and the staff is always friendly and polite.
One area for improvement would be the vet's service, which could be affiliated with a health plan, like Petlove, that would be perfect!
This place is amazing. I've been taking my son there since he was a baby and he's always been very well taken care of. I highly recommend it!
I really like DonPet, I've been taking my dog ​​there for over a year, I think the staff is super attentive to him and I think the price is fair!
Excellent service! Great care and attention for my pet.
